question: **Choose the correctly spelt word.**
solution:
The correct answer is "**Fulcrum**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the **correct spelling** and **meaning **of the given word.
 
• **Fulcrum**: 
 the point against which a lever is placed to get a purchase, or on which it turns or is supported; a thing that plays a central or essential role in an activity, event, or situation.

 
 
• 
 **Example**: *We can't lose him to our rivals, he is the **fulcrum**__** **of this project.*
 
 
 
 
• 
 ​*Hence, the correct answer is **option 3**.*
 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the correct spelling and meaning of the given word.
 
 
• **Fulcrum**: किसी चीज का समर्थन करने या उसे काम करने या घटित करने के लिए आवश्यक मुख्य चीज या व्यक्ति; सहयोग।
